def _create_website_service_request(service_key, full_name, phone, email, payload, files=None):
    if service_key not in SERVICE_REQUEST_KEYS:
        raise ValueError("Unknown service request type.")
    payload = dict(payload or {})
    available_packages = _service_pricing_summary(service_key)
    package = _service_pricing_package(service_key, request.form.get("package_choice"))
    if available_packages and not package:
        raise ValueError("Please choose the paid service package you want before submitting your request.")
    if package:
        payload["package_choice"] = package["code"]
        payload["package_label"] = package["name"]
        payload["package_price"] = package["price"]
        package_guidance = _service_package_guidance(service_key, payload, package["code"])
        if package_guidance:
            payload["package_check_status"] = "REVIEW"
            payload["package_recommended_code"] = package_guidance["recommended_code"]
            payload["package_recommended_label"] = package_guidance["recommended_name"]
            payload["package_recommended_price"] = package_guidance["recommended_price"]
            payload["package_check_reason"] = package_guidance["reason"]
            payload["package_override_confirmed"] = request.form.get("package_mismatch_confirmed") == "1"
            print(
                f"PACKAGE CHECK REVIEW: service={service_key} "
                f"selected={package['code']} recommended={package_guidance['recommended_code']} "
                f"client_override={payload['package_override_confirmed']}",
                flush=True,
            )
        else:
            payload["package_check_status"] = "MATCH"
    files = files or []
    with get_db() as conn:
        with conn.cursor() as cur:
            cur.execute(
                """
                INSERT INTO website_service_requests
                    (service_key,full_name,phone,email,payload,status,notification_status,created_at,updated_at)
                VALUES (%s,%s,%s,NULLIF(%s,''),%s::jsonb,'NEW','PENDING',NOW(),NOW())
                RETURNING id,created_at
                """,
                (service_key, full_name, phone, email, json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False)),
            )
            request_id, created_at = cur.fetchone()
            reference = _service_reference_for_id(request_id, created_at)
            cur.execute(
                "UPDATE website_service_requests SET reference=%s WHERE id=%s",
                (reference, request_id),
            )
            for filename, mime_type, data, digest in files:
                cur.execute(
                    """
                    INSERT INTO website_service_request_files
                        (request_id,filename,mime_type,file_bytes,byte_size,sha256)
                    VALUES (%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s)
                    ON CONFLICT (request_id,sha256) DO NOTHING
                    """,
                    (request_id, filename, mime_type, data, len(data), digest),
                )
        conn.commit()
    print(f"WEBSITE SERVICE REQUEST CREATED: {reference} service={service_key}", flush=True)
    _send_website_service_request_alert(request_id)
    return reference
